recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No FHIR-core follow-up is needed unless the Extension Pack loses coding-sctdescid; any future explanatory SNOMED CT guidance should be handled in the appropriate Extension Pack or terminology guidance source with approved wording.
issue_request: FHIR-12302 was Published/Persuasive for DSTU2 and asked to define a standard extension for SNOMED Description IDs, reference it on the SNOMED CT page, and consider the paired FHIR-12217 request.
initial_application: Historical commit e7180dea8444e0bc39f443e7306444ee80bb12c7 applied #12302 and #12217 by adding an sctdescid row to source/datatypes/coding-extensions-spreadsheet.xml and a Description Id Extension link from source/snomedct.html.
additional_context: Current FHIR-core no longer owns the live coding-sctdescid StructureDefinition: commit dd468d4f1799dd79819315b211588ef1cf4586e0 removed the old extension spreadsheet row, and commit 81e5862f203fdb8a03e9c943a7cf455aba8973f4 deleted the old SNOMED CT guidance page. Current core search finds coding-sctdescid only in source/oids.ini, while the live StructureDefinition is in HL7/fhir-extensions. Later related issues FHIR-33058 and FHIR-40724 are already represented on the combined branch as external-repo audits, and FHIR-32065 rejected a generic non-SNOMED version.
reconciliation: Published an empty external-repo audit commit with no FHIR-core source changes because the requested extension exists in the Extension Pack and the old core SNOMED CT page is no longer part of current core source.
